items.title: A graph-attentive GAN for rare-cell-aware single-cell RNA-seq data generation
items.title_zh: 一种用于稀有细胞感知单细胞RNA-seq数据生成的图注意力GAN
items.summary_zh: 单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）下游分析的一个核心挑战是高维小样本（HDSS）情形，且常因稀有细胞类型而加剧类别不平衡。这些因素阻碍了稳健的特征（基因）选择和细胞聚类，并限制了现有模拟器生成样本的真实性。我们提出GARAGE，一种图注意力稀有细胞感知单细胞数据生成方法，在先验噪声之外，用少量、注意力加权的真实细胞“泄漏”来增强生成器输入。具体来说，我们构建k近邻细胞图，并使用图注意力网络（GAT）优先选择可能代表欠采样（稀有）亚群的节点；这些高注意力细胞嵌入被注入生成器输入，以引导合成朝向数据流形中生物学上合理的区域，同时尊重细胞类型比例。这种注意力引导泄漏加速训练，减少模式丢失，并生成保留稀有细胞结构的真实合成细胞。在真实scRNA-seq基准上，GARAGE相比最先进基线改善了下游特征选择和聚类。总之，GARAGE通过将图注意力与对抗生成结合，直接应对scRNA-seq中的HDS

extra.description: A central challenge in downstream single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) analysis is the high-dimensional, small-sample (HDSS) regime, often compounded by class imbalance from rare cell types. These factors hinder robust feature (gene) selection and cell clustering and limit the realism of samples generated by existing simulators. We introduce GARAGE , a G raph- A ttentive RA re-cell aware single-cell data GE neration that augments the generator’s input with a small, attention-weighted ‘leakage’ of real cells in addition to prior noise. Specifically, we build a k -nearest-neighbour cell graph and use a graph attention network (GAT) to prioritize nodes that likely represent under-sampled (rare) subpopulations; these high-attention cell embeddings are injected into the generator input to steer synthesis toward biologically plausible regions of the data manifold while respecting cell-type proportions. This attention-guided leakage accelerates training, reduces mode dropping, and yields realistic synthetic cells that preserve rare-cell structure. Across real scRNA-seq benchmarks, GARAGE improves downstream feature selection and clustering compared with state-of-the-art baselines. In summary, GARAGE directly addresses HDSS and rarity in scRNA-seq by coupling graph attention with adversarial generation to produce high-fidelity synthetic cells that enhance downstream analyses. The corresponding software is available at: https://github.com/RitwikGanguly/GARAGE .

items.title: Topology-guided dual-masked contrastive learning for weakly supervised cell-type annotation in single-cell multi-omics
items.title_zh: 拓扑引导的双掩码对比学习用于单细胞多组学中的弱监督细胞类型注释
items.summary_zh: 摘要 单细胞多组学技术提供了细胞状态的互补视图，但受到普遍的特征稀疏性、显著的跨模态异质性和标记细胞严重短缺的挑战，阻碍了准确的细胞类型注释。我们提出双掩码对比学习（DMCL），一个拓扑引导的弱监督跨模态表示学习框架，在统一架构中解决这些挑战。DMCL 首先构建模态特异性 K 最近邻图以捕获每个组学层内的细胞-细胞拓扑关系。然后应用结合全局列掩码和局部随机掩码的双掩码策略，以模拟现实的特征缺失并正则化模型对抗技术噪声。随后通过图自编码器导出拓扑感知的潜在表示，忠实保留每个模态的局部细胞邻域结构。跨模态集成通过多头自注意力模块实现，该模块根据每个细胞的信息量动态加权模态特异性特征，实现上下文自适应模态融合。为进一步提高表示质量，DMCL 结合了双重对比目标，共同强制细胞内视图一致性和细胞间邻域结构，从而增强潜在空间中的跨模态对齐和结构保留。在多样化的真实和模拟数据集上的大量实验表明，DMCL

extra.description: Abstract Single-cell multi-omics technologies provide complementary views of cellular states, but are challenged by pervasive feature sparsity, pronounced cross-modality heterogeneity, and a critical shortage of labeled cells, hindering accurate cell-type annotation. We propose dual-masked contrastive learning (DMCL), a topology-guided weakly supervised cross-modal representation learning framework that addresses these challenges within a unified architecture. DMCL first constructs modality-specific K-nearest neighbor graphs to capture cell–cell topological relationships within each omics layer. A dual masking strategy combining global column-wise masking and local random masking is then applied to simulate realistic feature missingness and regularize the model against technical noise. Topology-aware latent representations are subsequently derived through a graph autoencoder that faithfully preserves the local cellular neighborhood structure of each modality. Cross-modal integration is achieved via a multi-head self-attention module that dynamically weights modality-specific features according to per-cell informativeness, enabling context-adaptive modality fusion. To further improve representation quality, DMCL incorporates a dual contrastive objective that jointly enforces intra-cell view consistency and inter-cell neighborhood structure, thereby enhancing both cross-modality alignment and structural preservation in the latent space. Extensive experiments on diverse real and simulated datasets demonstrate that DMCL achieves accurate cell-type annotation and superior clustering performance under minimal label supervision, establishing a principled and scalable foundation for weakly supervised single-cell multimodal analysis.

items.title: CALT-GNN: a graph neural network with cross-attention and long-tail experts for multi-omics cancer subtype classification
items.title_zh: CALT-GNN：一种用于多组学癌症亚型分类的交叉注意力和长尾专家图神经网络
items.summary_zh: 摘要 基于分子特征的癌症亚型分类对于表征肿瘤异质性、评估患者预后和支持精准治疗很重要。多组学整合提供了基因组、表观基因组、转录组和蛋白质组层面的互补分子信息。然而，多组学数据的高维性、复杂的跨组学关系和不平衡的亚型分布仍是主要挑战。为解决这些问题，我们提出CALT-GNN，一种图神经网络框架，整合患者相似性图学习、基于交叉注意力的组学整合、长尾专家分类和可学习预测融合。该框架首先构建组学特异性患者相似性图，使用图卷积网络学习潜在患者表示，并通过相似性网络融合获得统一图。交叉注意力分支将CNA和DNA甲基化作为源模态，mRNA表达作为目标模态，建模互补关系。并行地，长尾专家分支使用主要和次要专家，配合原型引导路由，执行类别分布感知分类。两个分支的输出随后使用可学习全局权重组合。在八个TCGA多组学队列上的实验表明，CALT-GNN相对于代表性基线方法取得了有竞争力或可比的分类性能，并在对类别

extra.description: Abstract Cancer subtype classification based on molecular features is important for characterizing tumor heterogeneity, evaluating patient prognosis, and supporting precision treatment. Multi-omics integration provides complementary molecular information across genomic, epigenomic, transcriptomic, and proteomic levels. However, the high dimensionality of multi-omics data, complex cross-omics relationships, and imbalanced subtype distributions remain major challenges. To address these issues, we propose CALT-GNN, a graph neural network framework that integrates patient-similarity graph learning, cross-attention-based omics integration, long-tail expert classification, and learnable prediction fusion. The framework first constructs omics-specific patient-similarity graphs, learns latent patient representations using graph convolutional networks, and obtains a unified graph through similarity network fusion. A cross-attention branch models complementary relationships between CNA and DNA methylation as source modalities and mRNA expression as the target modality. In parallel, a long-tail expert branch uses Major and Minor Experts with prototype-guided routing to perform class-distribution-aware classification. The outputs of the two branches are subsequently combined using a learnable global weight. Experiments on eight TCGA multi-omics cohorts showed that CALT-GNN achieved competitive or comparable classification performance relative to representative baseline methods and stable performance on Macro-F1 and MCC, which are sensitive to class imbalance. Ablation and subtype-level analyses further supported the complementary contributions of cross-omics interaction modeling and adaptive long-tail expert routing, although the magnitude of the improvements varied across cohorts and subtypes. These results suggest that CALT-GNN provides a methodological framework for multi-omics cancer subtype classification under complex cross-omics relationships and imbalanced subtype distributions.

items.title: CoMR: an integrative scoring pipeline for comprehensive mitochondrial proteome reconstruction across eukaryotes
items.title_zh: CoMR：一个整合评分流程，用于真核生物线粒体蛋白质组的全面重建
items.summary_zh: 摘要 从真核序列数据重建线粒体蛋白质组通常依赖预测线粒体靶向信号（MTS）。但MTS预测器主要基于模式生物训练，在系统发育差异大的谱系或靶向序列异常或缩短的生物中可能表现不佳。准确重建需要整合靶向预测之外的互补证据。我们开发了CoMR（综合线粒体重建器），一个整合流程，在统一评分框架中结合靶向预测、精选同源搜索、大规模相似性搜索和自动系统发育分析。在模式酵母酿酒酵母上基准测试，判别性能强（ROC-AUC=0.92），超过单独用TargetP2（N端靶向肽预测器，ROC-AUC=0.72）。在差异大的厌氧原生生物Paratrimastix pyriformis中，CoMR保持稳健性能（ROC-AUC=0.86），用实验蛋白质组验证，尽管类别极不平衡，精确率-召回率AUC为0.183（比随机预期高约78倍，比TargetP2好约10倍）。消融分析显示，预测性能对单层证据移除稳健，而重叠分析显示

extra.description: Abstract Mitochondrial proteome reconstruction from eukaryotic sequence data typically relies on prediction of mitochondrial targeting signals (MTSs). However, MTS predictors are primarily trained on model organisms and may perform poorly in phylogenetically divergent lineages or in organisms with atypical or reduced targeting sequences. Accurate reconstruction therefore requires integration of complementary sources of evidence beyond targeting prediction alone. We developed Comprehensive Mitochondrial Reconstructor (CoMR), an integrative workflow that combines targeting prediction, curated homology searches, large-scale similarity searches, and automated phylogenetic analysis within a unified scoring framework. Benchmarking on the model yeast Saccharomyces cerevisiae yielded strong discriminatory performance [receiver operating characteristic (ROC)-area under the curve (AUC) = 0.92], exceeding standalone prediction with TargetP2, a predictor of N-terminal targeting peptides (ROC-AUC = 0.72). In the divergent anaerobic protist Paratrimastix pyriformis, CoMR maintained robust performance (ROC-AUC = 0.86) validated with an experimental proteome despite extreme class imbalance, achieving a precision-recall AUC of 0.183 (~78-fold enrichment over random expectation and ~10-fold improvement over TargetP2). Ablation analyses demonstrate that predictive performance is robust to individual evidence-layer removal, while overlap analyses showed that homology-based searches recovered candidates missed by targeting predictors, particularly in P. pyriformis. Overall, CoMR improves mitochondrial proteome reconstruction over targeting prediction alone and provides a reproducible workflow for predicting mitochondrial and mitochondrion-related organelle protein repertoires across eukaryotes to aid investigations of organelle evolution and proteome reduction.

items.title: Robust prediction of drug combination side effects in realistic settings
items.title_zh: 在现实环境中稳健预测药物组合副作用
items.summary_zh: 药物组合引起的副作用是医疗保健中的重大挑战。对这些副作用的了解有限，因为临床试验通常参与者有限且测试的药物组合有限，往往无法检测到它们。我们提出DCSE（药物组合副作用），一种用于预测多重用药副作用的新型机器学习方法。DCSE学习药物、药物对和副作用的潜在特征，以预测给定药物组合中发生副作用的概率。我们首先在文献中常用实验设置下评估其性能。然而，这些设置依赖平衡测试数据集和采样负例，无法捕捉实践中遇到的高度不平衡和结构化的未知副作用集合。因此，本文的一个关键贡献是在前瞻性评估下引入更现实的实验设置。在这里，我们仅用该时期之前可用的数据训练后，尝试预测2009年至2014年间报告的副作用。这些评估包括热启动场景，即某些副作用对药物对已知，以及冷启动场景，即模型预测先前未表征药物对的副作用。我们的结果表明，DCSE始终优于最先进方法，证明其在现实应用中的稳健性和有效性。

extra.description: Side effects caused by drug combinations pose a major challenge in healthcare. Knowledge of these side effects is limited because often they are not detected in clinical trials, which typically involve a restricted number of participants and tested drug combinations. We introduce DCSE (Drug Combinations Side Effects), a novel machine learning method for predicting polypharmacy side effects. DCSE learns latent signatures for drugs, drug pairs, and side effects to predict the probability that a side effect occurs in a given drug combination. We first evaluate its performance in the commonly adopted experimental settings in the literature. However, these rely on balanced testing datasets and sampled negative examples, which do not capture the highly imbalanced and structured set of unknown side effects encountered in practice. Therefore, a key contribution of this paper is the introduction of more realistic experimental settings under prospective evaluations. Here, we attempt to predict side effects reported between 2009 and 2014 after training only on data available prior to that period. These evaluations include warm-start scenarios, in which some side effects are already known for a drug pair, and cold-start scenarios, in which the model predicts side effects for previously uncharacterized drug pairs. Our results indicate that DCSE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, demonstrating its robustness and efficacy in real-world applications.

items.title: FunFOLD5: Combining Localised Templates and Structural Homology for Accurate Predictions of Biologically Relevant Protein-Ligand Interactions.
items.title_zh: FunFOLD5：结合局部模板和结构同源性，准确预测生物学相关的蛋白质-配体相互作用。
items.summary_zh: 蛋白质-配体建模的一个核心挑战是不仅预测相互作用的存在，还要预测正确的配体身份、结合位点位置和生物学相关的结合构象。虽然AlphaFold3和Boltz-2等最新深度学习方法在建模蛋白质-配体复合物方面表现出令人印象深刻的准确性，但这些方法通常需要配体的先验知识，专注于单一主导结合姿态，并严重依赖大型训练数据集。基于模板的方法通过利用实验解析的蛋白质-配体复合物来转移结合位点结构和配体化学身份，提供了一种互补解决方案，即使对于未表征或工程化的蛋白质也能进行功能推断。然而，传统基于模板的方法受限于其对全局折叠相似性的依赖，可能错过对配体特异性至关重要的局部结合特征。局部模板搜索策略可以通过捕获保守的口袋级相互作用来克服这一限制，从而在多样化的蛋白质家族中实现更准确且功能相关的配体结合预测。我们提出了FunFOLD5，一种基于模板的蛋白质-配体结合位点预测方法。其前身FunFOLD4依赖全局折

extra.description: A central challenge in protein-ligand modelling is to predict not only the presence of an interaction, but also the correct ligand identity, binding-site location, and biologically relevant bound conformation. While recent deep learning approaches such as AlphaFold3 and Boltz-2 have demonstrated impressive accuracy in modelling protein-ligand complexes, these methods typically require prior knowledge of the ligand, focus on a single dominant binding pose, and rely heavily on large training datasets. Template-based methods offer a complementary solution by leveraging experimentally resolved protein-ligand complexes to transfer both binding-site architecture and ligand chemical identity, enabling function inference even for uncharacterised or engineered proteins. However, conventional template-based methods are limited by their dependence on global fold similarity, which can miss local binding features critical for ligand specificity. Localised template search strategies may overcome this limitation by capturing conserved pocket-level interactions, enabling more accurate and functionally relevant ligand-binding predictions across diverse protein families. We present FunFOLD5, a template-based method for predicting protein-ligand binding sites. Whereas its predecessor FunFOLD4 relied on global fold similarity to identify templates, FunFOLD5 combines local and global searches, integrating rapid structural template retrieval with a local targeted protocol to improve interaction accuracy. The pipeline combines Foldseek-based template searching, curated ligand annotations from BioLiP2, and ligand superposition followed by spatial clustering to identify associated ligands and consensus binding sites. Benchmarking on blind targets from CASP15 and CASP16 demonstrates robust performance across a wide range of biologically relevant ligands, including nucleotides, metal ions, cofactors, and small metabolites. FunFOLD5 achieved high-accuracy predictions for 81.2% of ligand instances (56 of 69). Importantly, the local targeted protocol consistently improved ligand identification, residue-level recall, and binding-pose accuracy. FunFOLD5 is freely available as a Dockerised pipeline at https://hub.docker.com/r/radiyaman/funfold5_template, providing a scalable and reproducible framework for large-scale protein-ligand interaction analysis and functional annotation. Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

items.title: Spatial Transcriptomics As Rasterized Image Tensors (STARIT) characterizes cell states with subcellular molecular heterogeneity
items.title_zh: 空间转录组学作为栅格化图像张量（STARIT）以亚细胞分子异质性表征细胞状态
items.summary_zh: 基于成像的空间分辨转录组学（imSRT）技术提供了细胞内基因的高通量分子分辨率空间表征。传统的 imSRT 数据分析方法通过统计每个分割细胞中每个基因检测到的 mRNA 分子数来生成基因计数矩阵，从而识别细胞类型和状态，因此忽略了可用于定义细胞状态的亚细胞异质性。为了利用 imSRT 数据中的分子分辨率信息，并有可能基于亚细胞异质性识别细胞状态，我们开发了 STARIT（空间转录组学作为栅格化图像张量）。STARIT 将 imSRT 数据中分割细胞内的转录本转换为基于图像的张量表示，可与深度学习计算机视觉模型结合用于下游分析。使用模拟和真实 imSRT 数据，我们证明 STARIT 能区分转录上不同的细胞类型，并进一步根据亚细胞转录本定位区分细胞状态，而传统基因计数分析无法捕捉这一点。通过提供一个标准化框架来编码 imSRT 数据中的亚细胞分子信息，STARIT 将有助于更深入地理解亚细胞

extra.description: Imaging-based spatially resolved transcriptomics (imSRT) technologies provide high-throughput molecular-resolution spatial characterization of genes within cells. Conventional analysis methods to identify cell-types and states in imSRT data rely on gene count matrices derived from tallying the number of mRNA molecules detected for each gene per segmented cell, thereby overlooking subcellular heterogeneity that can be useful in defining cell states. To take advantage of the molecular-resolution information in imSRT data and potentially identify cell-states based on subcellular heterogeneity, we developed STARIT (Spatial Transcriptomics As Rasterized Image Tensors). STARIT converts transcripts within segmented cells in imSRT data into an image-based tensor representation that can be combined with deep learning computer vision models for downstream analysis. Using simulated and real imSRT data, we demonstrate that STARIT distinguishes transcriptionally distinct cell-types and further separates cell states based on subcellular transcript localization, which conventional gene count analysis fails to capture. By providing a standardized framework to encode subcellular molecular information in imSRT data, STARIT will enable deeper insights into subcellular heterogeneity and enhance the identification and characterization of cell-types and states that are overlooked by gene count representations.

items.title: Spatial cell-cell communication inference based on cell-spot-ligand-receptor heterogeneous graphs
items.title_zh: 基于细胞-斑点-配体-受体异构图的空间细胞-细胞通讯推断
items.summary_zh: 细胞-细胞通讯对组织稳态和疾病相关微环境重塑至关重要。空间转录组学使得原位研究通讯事件成为可能，但从基于斑点的数据进行单细胞分辨率推断仍具挑战性，原因包括细胞到斑点的映射不确定、局部空间信息利用有限，以及配体-受体共表达导致的假阳性。现有方法在细胞-细胞通讯推断中越来越强调空间邻近性，而整合生物学信息信号对于提高候选通讯事件的可解释性仍然重要。在此，我们提出 SpaHCC，一个整合单细胞转录组学、空间转录组学和先验配体-受体知识的异构图学习框架，用于空间细胞-细胞通讯推断。通过联合利用分子特征、空间邻域信息和细胞功能状态，SpaHCC 对候选通讯事件进行优先级排序，并通过通路、转录因子和受体侧响应分析支持其生物学情境化。基准和空间一致性分析表明，SpaHCC 恢复了空间连贯的候选通讯信号。在阿尔茨海默病数据中，SpaHCC 识别出反复出现的兴奋性神经元相关候选模式，包括与突触重塑和炎症相关

extra.description: Cell-cell communication is essential for tissue homeostasis and disease-associated microenvironment remodeling. Spatial transcriptomics enables the study of communication events in situ , but single-cell-resolution inference from spot-based data remains challenging because of uncertain cell-to-spot mapping, limited use of local spatial information, and false positives from ligand-receptor co-expression. Existing methods increasingly emphasize spatial proximity in cell-cell communication inference, while integrating biologically informative signals remains important for improving the interpretability of candidate communication events. Here, we present SpaHCC, a heterogeneous graph learning framework that integrates single-cell transcriptomics, spatial transcriptomics, and prior ligand-receptor knowledge for spatial cell-cell communication inference. By jointly leveraging molecular features, spatial neighborhood information, and cellular functional states, SpaHCC prioritizes candidate communication events and supports their biological contextualization through pathway, transcription factor, and receptor-side response analyses. Benchmark and spatial consistency analyses showed that SpaHCC recovered spatially coherent candidate communication signals. In Alzheimer’s disease data, SpaHCC identified recurrent excitatory neuron-associated candidate patterns, including NRXN- and FLRT2-related modules associated with synaptic remodeling and inflammation-related transcriptional programs. Cross-patient analyses showed recurrence of selected AD-associated candidate patterns, while representative cSCC and PDAC analyses illustrated the spatial interpretability of the framework in additional disease contexts. Overall, SpaHCC provides an effective and interpretable framework for spatially resolved cell-cell communication analysis in complex diseases.

items.title: RMGAT: a Relational Multi-Scale Graph Attention Network for spatial transcriptomics domain identification with systematic component ablation
items.title_zh: RMGAT：一种用于空间转录组学域识别的关系多尺度图注意力网络及系统性组件消融
items.summary_zh: 摘要 背景 从空间转录组学数据中映射空间连贯的组织域是表征细胞类型、发育模式以及疾病相关组织结构破坏的前提。虽然图神经网络（GNN）方法在域识别方面较仅基于表达的聚类有显著改进，但边特征设计（即组织斑点之间的空间连接如何表示）的影响从未被系统评估。所有现有方法都使用单一标量边权重，这使得多维边特征是否有益仍悬而未决。方法 我们提出 RMGAT，一种关系多尺度图注意力网络，据我们所知首次将多维学习边特征应用于空间转录组学。每条空间边由 8 维学习特征向量描述。我们将其与三组件训练目标（图重建、NT-Xent 对比学习和自表达解码器）以及使用共识聚类、匈牙利标签对齐和空间细化的 V30 后处理流程相结合。结果 在 12 切片 DLPFC（人背外侧前额叶皮层）基准上通过 60 次独立运行（5 个种子 × 12 个 DLPFC 切片）评估，RMGAT 达到平均调整兰德指数（ARI）0.3422 ±

extra.description: Abstract Background Mapping spatially coherent tissue domains from spatial transcriptomics data is a prerequisite for characterizing cell-type, developmental patterning, and disease-associated disruptions of tissue architecture. While graph neural network (GNN) methods have substantially improved domain identification over expression-only clustering, the effect of edge feature design (i.e. how spatial connections between tissue spots are represented) has never been systematically evaluated. All existing methods use a single scalar edge weight, leaving open the question of whether multi-dimensional edge features provide any benefit. Methods We introduce RMGAT, a Relational Multi-Scale Graph Attention Network that applies multi-dimensional learned edge features to spatial transcriptomics, to the best of our knowledge for the first time. Each spatial edge is described by an 8-dimensional learned feature vector. We combine this with a three-component training objective (graph reconstruction, NT-Xent contrastive learning, and a self-expression decoder) and a V30 post-processing pipeline using consensus clustering, Hungarian label alignment, and spatial refinement. Results Evaluated on the 12-section DLPFC (human dorsolateral prefrontal cortex) benchmark across 60 independent runs (5 seeds × 12 DLPFC sections), RMGAT achieves a mean adjusted Rand index (ARI) of 0.3422 ± 0.0402 (95% confidence interval [0.332, 0.353]), comparable to SpaGCN (~ 0.36). A systematic four-component ablation study with formal statistical testing identifies GAT attention as the only statistically confirmed essential contributor (ΔARI = − 0.028 when replaced with a graph convolutional network, GCN; p < 0.0001). Contrastive learning shows a directional benefit (ΔARI = − 0.017; p = 0.024 vs. scalar-weight baseline). The 8-dimensional EdgeMLP and self-expression decoder are both neutral (ΔARI ≈ 0.004; both p > 0.3), indicating neither contributes at PCA-50 input quality. Conclusions The primary contribution of this work is a systematic ablation study providing evidence-based design guidance for spatial transcriptomics GNNs. At PCA-50 input quality, GAT attention is the statistically confirmed critical component; contrastive learning is beneficial ( p = 0.024); multi-dimensional edge features and additional decoder objectives do not improve performance under this input regime. For practitioners, these findings support using GAT attention ( p < 0.0001) and contrastive learning ( p = 0.024, non-significant after Bonferroni correction), and investing in node feature quality over edge feature complexity.

items.title: spMosaic: multi-sample integration for scalable spatial domain discovery based on spatial transcriptomics
items.title_zh: spMosaic：基于空间转录组学的多样本整合，用于可扩展空间域发现
items.summary_zh: 摘要 空间转录组学能够在完整组织结构内对基因表达进行高分辨率分析，为研究组织结构和细胞类型的空间组织提供了新机会。然而，由于批次效应、个体间异质性、数据集规模不断增加以及独立处理组织切片之间空间坐标不可比，识别跨样本和个体可重复的空间域仍然具有挑战性。我们提出spMosaic，一个用于多样本空间域识别的可扩展计算框架。该方法整合了两个关键组成部分：(i) 基于广义加性模型的空间平滑，用于识别跨样本共享的空间可变基因；(ii) 一个批次感知的双编码器自编码器，学习低维表示，同时促使样本相关变异与域相关生物变异分开表示。随后的深度嵌入聚类细化步骤进一步改善推断域分配的分离度和紧凑性。我们在涵盖五种技术的多样数据集中，在单个体和多个体设置下，将spMosaic与九种现有方法进行了评估。与现有方法相比，spMosaic始终实现较强的聚类性能，同时保持有竞争力的样本整合。此外，在我们基准中使用的计算

extra.description: Abstract Spatial transcriptomics enables high-resolution profiling of gene expression within intact tissue architecture, providing new opportunities to study the spatial organization of tissue structures and cell types. However, identifying spatial domains that are reproducible across samples and individuals remains challenging due to batch effects, inter-individual heterogeneity, increasing dataset sizes and the incomparability of spatial coordinates across independently processed tissue sections. We propose spMosaic, a scalable computational framework for multi-sample spatial domain identification. The method integrates two key components: (i) generalized additive model–based spatial smoothing to identify spatially variable genes shared across samples, and (ii) a batch-aware dual-encoder autoencoder that learns low-dimensional representations while encouraging sample-associated variation to be represented separately from domain-relevant biological variation. A subsequent deep embedded clustering refinement step further improves the separation and compactness of inferred domain assignments. We evaluated spMosaic against nine existing methods in both single-individual and multi-individual settings across diverse datasets spanning five technologies. spMosaic consistently achieved strong clustering performance relative to existing methods while maintaining competitive sample integration. In addition, under the computational settings used in our benchmark, spMosaic was the only method among those evaluated that successfully scaled to a large cohort, enabling the analysis of 378 918 spatial spots from 31 frontal cortex samples across 12 mice. These results demonstrate that spMosaic provides an integrative and scalable approach for multi-sample spatial transcriptomics analysis, enabling accurate and interpretable characterization of spatial tissue organization.

items.title: ELISA (Embedding-Linked Interactive Single-cell Agent): an interpretable hybrid generative Artificial Intelligence agent for expression-grounded discovery in single-cell genomics
items.title_zh: ELISA（嵌入链接交互式单细胞代理）：一种用于单细胞基因组学中表达基础发现的可解释混合生成人工智能代理
items.summary_zh: 摘要 将单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）数据转化为机制性生物学假设仍然是一个关键瓶颈，因为代理AI系统缺乏对转录组表示的直接访问，而表达基础模型对自然语言仍然不透明。在这里，我们介绍ELISA（嵌入链接交互式单细胞代理），一个可解释框架，统一了单细胞生成预训练变换器表达嵌入与基于生物医学双向编码器表示的变换器语义检索和大语言模型（LLM）介导的解释，用于交互式单细胞发现。自动查询分类器根据查询是基因特征、自然语言概念还是两者的混合，将输入路由到基因标记评分、语义匹配或倒数排名融合管道。集成分析模块执行60+基因集的通路活性评分、使用280+精选对的配体-受体相互作用预测、条件感知比较分析和细胞类型比例估计，所有这些都直接在嵌入数据上操作，无需访问原始计数矩阵。在涵盖炎症性肺病、儿童和成人癌症、类器官模型、健康组织和神经发育的六个多样化scRNA-seq数据集上进行基准测试，ELISA

extra.description: Abstract Translating single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data into mechanistic biological hypotheses remains a critical bottleneck, as agentic AI systems lack direct access to transcriptomic representations while expression foundation models remain opaque to natural language. Here, we introduce ELISA (Embedding-Linked Interactive Single-cell Agent), an interpretable framework that unifies single-cell generative pretrained transformer expression embeddings with biomedical bidirectional encoder representations from transformers-based semantic retrieval and large-language model (LLM)-mediated interpretation for interactive single-cell discovery. An automatic query classifier routes inputs to gene marker scoring, semantic matching, or reciprocal rank fusion pipelines depending on whether the query is a gene signature, natural language concept, or mixture of both. Integrated analytical modules perform pathway activity scoring across 60+ gene sets, ligand–receptor interaction prediction using 280+ curated pairs, condition-aware comparative analysis, and cell-type proportion estimation, all operating directly on embedded data without access to the original count matrix. Benchmarked across six diverse scRNA-seq datasets spanning inflammatory lung disease, pediatric and adult cancers, organoid models, healthy tissue, and neurodevelopment, ELISA significantly outperforms CellWhisperer, a classical lexical retriever (BM25), and a random baseline in cell type retrieval (combined permutation test, $p < 2\times 10^{-5}$ for each), with particularly large gains on gene-signature queries (Cohen’s $d = 5.98$ for mean reciprocal rank). ELISA replicates published biological findings (mean composite score 0.88), and generates candidate hypotheses through grounded LLM reasoning, bridging the gap between transcriptomic data exploration and biological discovery.

items.title: BOMIFA: biologically informed multi-omics integration with graph contrastive learning for cancer prognosis in women
items.title_zh: BOMIFA：基于生物学信息的多组学整合与图对比学习用于女性癌症预后
items.summary_zh: 摘要 准确的生存预测仍然是精准肿瘤学的核心挑战，特别是对于女性患者，其性别特异性分子特征在先前研究中往往建模不足。尽管多组学整合能够更深入地探索预后生物标志物，但现有方法依赖数学驱动的融合策略，往往会稀释组学特异性信号，且无法捕捉跨组学层的生物调控层级。为解决这些局限，我们提出 BOMIFA（生物学信息组学表示与多组学整合框架），一种基于深度图的框架，利用DNA甲基化、mRNA和miRNA表达数据对女性患者进行生存预测和生物标志物发现。BOMIFA包含两项关键创新。首先，在每个组学编码器内利用图对比学习增强组内表示学习并放大预后相关信号。然后，部署生物学信息跨组学注意力机制，明确建模方向性调控依赖关系，实现与已知分子层级一致的组学间信息交换。在八个癌症队列上的广泛基准测试表明，BOMIFA在女性患者中持续优于现有预后方法。此外，基于显著性图的梯度归因能够识别先前混合性别分析中被忽视的女性相

extra.description: Abstract Accurate survival prediction remains a central challenge in precision oncology, particularly for female patients whose sex-specific molecular characteristics are often under-modeled in prior studies. Although multi-omics integration enables a deeper exploration of prognostic biomarkers, existing methods rely on mathematically driven fusion strategies, which tend to dilute omics-specific signals and fail to capture biological regulatory hierarchies across omics layers. To address these limitations, we propose BOMIFA (Biologically informed Omics representation and Multi-omics Integration Framework), a deep graph-based framework for survival prediction and biomarker discovery in female patients using DNA methylation, mRNA, and miRNA expression data. BOMIFA incorporates two key innovations. First, graph contrastive learning is leveraged within each omics encoder to enhance intra-omics representation learning and amplify prognostically relevant signals. Then, a biologically informed cross-omics attention mechanism is deployed to explicitly model directional regulatory dependencies, enabling inter-omics information exchange aligned with known molecular hierarchies. Extensive benchmarking on eight cancer cohorts demonstrates that BOMIFA consistently outperforms existing prognostic methods in female patients. Moreover, saliency map-based gradient attribution enables the identification of female-associated prognostic biomarkers that were overlooked in prior mixed-sex analyses.

items.title: Single-cell-level perturbation-induced and condition-related signal estimation with batch effect removal using NDreamer
items.title_zh: 使用NDreamer进行单细胞级扰动诱导和条件相关信号估计并去除批次效应
items.summary_zh: 摘要 测序技术的进步和单细胞数据量的增长为揭示由实验扰动因果诱导或与疾病条件统计相关（但不一定因果）的基因表达模式创造了前所未有的机会。然而，当前分析方法未能充分考虑批次效应和数据稀疏性，或未能捕捉单细胞数据中固有的非线性，导致估计偏差。为解决这些局限，我们开发了NDreamer，结合神经离散表示学习和匹配来去除批次效应并在单细胞分辨率估计扰动诱导或条件相关信号。NDreamer通过对离散潜在变量使用互信息损失将细胞内在特征与条件或批次效应解耦，同时通过三元组和局部邻域损失保留批次和条件内的全局和局部方差，从而优于现有方法。我们将NDreamer应用于跨平台、器官和物种的多个数据集，并验证和基准测试了其在去除批次效应和估计扰动诱导或条件相关信号方面的性能。特别是，我们将NDreamer应用于阿尔茨海默病队列，揭示了区分痴呆患者与对照组的生物学相关基因表达模式。

extra.description: Abstract Advances in sequencing technologies and the growing volume of single-cell data have created unprecedented opportunities for uncovering gene expression patterns causally induced by experimental perturbations or statistically associated, but not necessarily causal, with disease conditions. However, current analytical methods inadequately account for batch effects and data sparsity or fail to capture the inherent non-linearity in single-cell data, leading to biased estimation. To address these limitations, we developed NDreamer that combines neural discrete representation learning and matching to remove batch effects and estimate perturbation-induced or condition-associated signals at single-cell resolution. NDreamer outperformed existing methods by using mutual information loss on discrete latent variables to disentangle cells’ intrinsic features from conditions or batch effects, while preserving both global and local variance within batches and conditions via triplet and local neighborhood loss. We applied NDreamer to multiple datasets across platforms, organs, and species and validated and benchmarked its performance in removing batch effects and estimating perturbation-induced or condition-associated signals. In particular, we applied NDreamer to an Alzheimer’s disease cohort, revealing biologically relevant gene expression patterns that distinguish dementia patients from controls.

items.title: From descriptive to generative: foundation-model approaches for spatial transcriptomics
items.title_zh: 从描述到生成：空间转录组学的基础模型方法
items.summary_zh: 摘要 空间转录组学通过在原生组织环境中映射基因表达，推进了生物系统的研究。然而，内在的高维度、显著的数据稀疏性以及组织形态与转录组之间复杂的非线性关系，对传统分析框架捕获长程生物依赖关系构成了挑战。本文引入一个统一的概念框架，称为“细胞如词，组织如句”，用于考察大型语言模型（LLM）和其他基础模型方法的上下文学习和生成能力如何应用于表征组织的空间组织。我们综合已发表研究的证据，表明基于 Transformer 的 LLM、Mamba/状态空间模型和基于扩散的模型已被应用于空间域识别、细胞-细胞相互作用推断和跨模态对齐等任务。这种从描述性分析向生成建模的转变支持重建和预测任务，同时强调需要对扰动和时空推断进行严格验证。最终，该框架提供了一个系统视角，用于整合空间信息并评估基础模型已展示的能力和局限性，同时识别生成关于组织组织和疾病进展的可检验假设的机会。

extra.description: Abstract Spatial transcriptomics has advanced the study of biological systems by facilitating the mapping of gene expression within native tissue environments. Nevertheless, the intrinsic high dimensionality, pronounced data sparsity, and intricate nonlinear relationships between tissue morphology and the transcriptome pose challenges for conventional analytical frameworks in capturing long-range biological dependencies. This manuscript introduces a unified conceptual framework, termed “cells as words, tissues as sentences,” for examining how the contextual learning and generative capabilities of large language models (LLMs) and other foundation-model approaches can be applied to characterize the spatial organization of tissues. We synthesize evidence from published studies showing that Transformer-based LLMs, Mamba/state-space models, and diffusion-based models have been applied to tasks including spatial domain identification, cell–cell interaction inference, and cross-modal alignment. This shift from descriptive analysis toward generative modeling supports reconstruction and prediction tasks, while highlighting the need for rigorous validation of perturbational and spatiotemporal inference. Ultimately, this framework provides a systematic perspective for integrating spatial information and evaluating the demonstrated capabilities and limitations of foundation models, while identifying opportunities for generating testable hypotheses about tissue organization and disease progression.

items.title: scASprofiler: profiling single-cell RNA splicing with a deep convolutional generative network
items.title_zh: scASprofiler：用深度卷积生成网络分析单细胞RNA剪接
items.summary_zh: 摘要 单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）使得在细胞分辨率下研究可变剪接（AS）成为可能。然而，scRNA-seq数据中的AS分析受到稀疏剪接连接覆盖度的限制，这是每个细胞低测序深度的结果。这一限制在3′偏向的液滴式方案中尤为明显。为克服这一问题，我们开发了 scASprofiler，一种专门设计的深度卷积生成网络，用于以单细胞分辨率解析AS。scASprofiler通过利用掩码感知变分自编码器-生成对抗网络（VAE-GAN）生成的细胞，对连接读数进行缺失值插补，减少插补值的过度平滑并保留具有生物学意义的异质性。在基准测试中，scASprofiler增强了对细胞群体的 delineation 和剪接信号的恢复。应用于板和液滴平台生成的数据集时，scASprofiler揭示了隐秘AS事件和细胞类型特异性AS模式，补充并扩展了从基因表达中获得的见解。总之，我们的研究确立了 scASprofi

extra.description: Abstract Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) enables the investigation of alternative splicing (AS) at cellular resolution. However, the analysis of AS in scRNA-seq data is constrained by sparse splice-junction coverage, a consequence of low sequencing depth per cell. This limitation is particularly pronounced in 3′-biased, droplet-based protocols. To overcome this, we developed scASprofiler, a tailored deep convolutional generative network designed to decipher AS with single-cell resolution. scASprofiler performs missing-value imputation of junction read counts by leveraging cells generated by a mask-aware variational autoencoder-generative adversarial network (VAE-GAN), reducing oversmoothing of imputed values and preserving biologically meaningful heterogeneity. Across benchmarks, scASprofiler enhances delineation of cell populations and recovery of splicing signals. When applied to datasets generated using plate- and droplet-based platforms, scASprofiler uncovers cryptic AS events and reveals cell-type-specific AS patterns that complement and extend insights derived from gene expression. Together, our study establishes scASprofiler as a robust and versatile tool for dissecting AS landscapes from scRNA-seq data.

items.title: Decoding cell–cell communication in spatial transcriptomics: mechanistic insights, modeling constraints, and analytical caveats
items.title_zh: 解码空间转录组中的细胞间通讯：机制洞见、建模约束和分析陷阱
items.summary_zh: 摘要 细胞间通讯（CCC）对维持组织结构和驱动生物进程至关重要，但长期以来从转录组数据推断CCC受限于缺乏空间背景。空间转录组（ST）的进展现在能通过保留细胞及其微环境的物理组织，进行机制驱动的CCC分析。在这篇综述中，我们考察了从ST数据推断CCC的最新方法学进展，聚焦统计、最优传输和深度学习框架如何整合空间信息来建模配体-受体（LR）相互作用和下游信号。我们还总结了空间和非空间CCC方法共有的关键机制驱动组件。此外，我们讨论组织异质性和空间结构如何引入背景依赖偏差，特别是对基于置换的推断，并概述机制考量，如LR生化、信号转导和条件特异性通讯。我们进一步强调整理细胞间传导和细胞内信号过程的数据库。通过整合空间约束与生化和计算原理，这篇综述对当前方法的机会和局限提供了综合评估。我们最后指出关键方法学挑战和未来方向，以开发稳健、可扩展且机制可解释的CCC推断，随着ST技术持续进步。

extra.description: Abstract Cell–cell communication (CCC) is essential for maintaining tissue organization and driving biological progression, yet its inference from transcriptomic data has long been limited by the absence of spatial context. Advances in spatial transcriptomics (ST) now enable mechanistically grounded analyses of CCC by preserving the physical organization of cells and their microenvironments. In this review, we examine recent methodological developments in CCC inference from ST data, focusing on how statistical, optimal transport, and deep learning frameworks incorporate spatial information to model ligand–receptor (LR) interactions and downstream signaling. We also summarize key mechanism-driven components shared across spatial and non-spatial CCC approaches. In addition, we discuss how tissue heterogeneity and spatial architecture can introduce context-dependent biases, particularly for permutation-based inference, and outline mechanistic considerations such as LR biochemistry, signal transduction, and condition-specific communication. We further highlight databases that curate intercellular conduction and intracellular signaling processes. By integrating spatial constraints with biochemical and computational principles, this review offers an integrated assessment of the opportunities and limitations of current approaches. We conclude by identifying key methodological challenges and future directions for developing robust, scalable, and mechanistically interpretable CCC inference as ST technologies continue to advance.

items.title: AResKGLM: a graph-grounded language-model framework for interpretable multi-hop antimicrobial resistance reasoning
items.title_zh: AResKGLM：一种图接地语言模型框架，用于可解释的多跳抗菌素耐药性推理
items.summary_zh: 摘要 抗菌素耐药性（AMR）威胁微生物学和微生物组生物信息学，因为耐药表型由微生物群落中基因、移动遗传元件和功能环境间的相互作用塑造。优先排序耐药决定因素需要模型跨知识图谱（KG）推理，连接基因、蛋白质、途径、药物和微生物表型。现有基于图的方法将这些证据压缩为标量分数，而大型语言模型能产生不基于结构化证据的解释。我们开发了AResKGLM（抗菌素耐药性知识图谱语言模型），一种图接地语言模型框架，用于可解释的微生物AMR生物信息学，将广度优先搜索检索的多跳路径和每实体生物医学描述序列化为结构化上下文-路径-问题提示。Llama-3-8B和DeepSeek-R1-7B通过QLoRA适应，产生二元链接预测和简洁推理轨迹。在KIDs基准上，AResKGLM（Llama-3-8B）达到F1=0.8482，优于KG-BERT（0.7213）、NBFNet（0.5260）和ULTRA（0.2541）（配

extra.description: Abstract Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) threatens microbiology and microbiome bioinformatics because resistance phenotypes are shaped by interactions among genes, mobile genetic elements, and functional environments across microbial communities. Prioritizing resistance determinants requires models that reason across knowledge graphs (KGs) linking genes, proteins, pathways, drugs, and microbial phenotypes. Existing graph-based methods compress this evidence into scalar scores, whereas large language models can produce explanations not grounded in structured evidence. We developed AResKGLM (Antimicrobial Resistance Knowledge Graph Language Model), a graph-grounded language-model framework for interpretable microbial AMR bioinformatics that serializes breadth-first-search-retrieved multi-hop paths and per-entity biomedical descriptions into a structured Context–Path–Question prompt. Llama-3-8B and DeepSeek-R1-7B are adapted with QLoRA to produce binary link predictions and concise reasoning traces. On the KIDs benchmark, AResKGLM (Llama-3-8B) achieved F1 = 0.8482, outperforming KG-BERT (0.7213), NBFNet (0.5260), and ULTRA (0.2541) (paired Wilcoxon $p = 1.2 \times 10^{-7}$). Its advantage increased with reasoning depth: F1 decreased from 0.9197 at 2 hops to 0.8148 at 6 hops, whereas KG-BERT dropped from 0.8110 to 0.6716. Counterfactual path corruption produced an apparent F1 of 0.000, mechanically forced by the probe label assignment; the operative diagnostic is the per-sample flip rate (0.04–0.16), consistent with sensitivity to supplied biological evidence rather than reliance on pretrained priors alone. Cross-species evaluation yielded F1 = 0.81–0.88 with Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC) = 0.35–0.54 on Mycobacterium tuberculosis, Pseudomonas aeruginosa, and Staphylococcus aureus. Temporal ranking of 81 post-2022 gene–drug associations achieved Precision@20 = 100% and AUC-PR = 0.855. AResKGLM offers an interpretable, reproducible framework for multi-hop AMR reasoning, linking candidate prioritization with mechanism-oriented hypothesis generation.

items.title: Stepwise multi-scale reconstruction of cell spatial organization from single-cell RNA sequencing data with Cell2space
items.title_zh: 使用Cell2space从单细胞RNA测序数据逐步多尺度重建细胞空间组织
items.summary_zh: 摘要 阐明细胞的空间组织是理解组织结构与功能的基础，但单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）过程中的组织解离会使细胞失去其原生结构背景。将scRNA-seq数据与空间转录组学（ST）参考整合，以推断单个细胞的空间信息至关重要。尽管已经开发了各种工具，但实现精确且具有生物学相关性的空间重建仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们提出Cell2space，一个深度学习框架，它将scRNA-seq数据与ST参考整合，以逐步方式重建多尺度细胞空间组织。Cell2space不将空间重建视为坐标回归，而是学习一个通用空间亲和函数，并采用分层推断策略，整合域级先验以细化细胞邻域。这种方法能够准确地将单细胞分配到空间域，并推断细胞–细胞邻域关系。综合评估表明，Cell2space在域分配和邻域推断方面都稳健地取得了优越性能。应用于小鼠视觉皮层和人类皮肤时，Cell2space识别层特异性标志物，揭示连续基因表达梯度，

extra.description: Abstract Elucidating the spatial organization of cells is fundamental to understanding tissue architecture and function, yet tissue dissociation during single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) strips cells of their native architectural context. It is essential to integrate scRNA-seq data with spatial transcriptomics (ST) references to infer the spatial information of individual cells. Despite the development of various tools, achieving precise and biologically relevant spatial reconstructions remains challenging. Here, we present Cell2space, a deep learning framework that integrates scRNA-seq data with ST references to reconstruct multi-scale cellular spatial organization in a stepwise manner. Instead of treating spatial reconstruction as coordinate regression, Cell2space learns a universal spatial affinity function and employs a hierarchical inference strategy that integrates domain-level priors to refine cellular neighborhoods. This approach enables accurate assignment of single cells to spatial domains and inference of cell–cell neighborhood relationships. Comprehensive evaluations demonstrate that Cell2space robustly achieves superior performance in both domain assignment and neighborhood inference. Applied to the mouse visual cortex and human skin, Cell2space identifies layer-specific markers, reveals continuous gene expression gradients, and faithfully reconstructs stratified tissue architecture without requiring prior annotations. Together, Cell2space provides a powerful framework for integrating single-cell and spatial modalities, enabling deeper insights into tissue organization and cellular microenvironments.

items.title: 基于多智能体深度强化学习的SD-IoT控制器部署
items.title_zh: 基于多智能体深度强化学习的SD-IoT控制器部署
items.summary_zh: 物联网(IoT)中激增的流量, 影响了传感器等设备的数据传输。利用软件定义网络(SDN)技术可以优化网络性能, 提高数据传输质量。然而, 物联网中流量等网络状态的不断变化会影响软件定义网络控制平面的性能。研究软件定义物联网(SD-IoT)中的动态控制器部署问题, 以在流量变化时保证控制平面性能。考虑到物联网节点的能耗以及数据传输的特点, 在部署控制器时, 综合考虑延迟、控制可靠性以及能耗的影响, 并将该问题构建为马尔可夫博弈过程。为了同时兼顾单一控制器性能以及控制平面整体性能, 采用多智能体深度强化学习求解该问题。在部署阶段利用动作掩码屏蔽部分节点, 避免将控制器部署在性能不足或者供能不方便的节点。仿真实验表明, 与基于Louvain社区划分和基于单智能体深度Q网络(DQN)的部署算法相比, 所提算法可以更好地找到高性能的部署方案。

items.title: 云网融合环境下组合服务的动态重构

items.summary_zh: 随着云计算与空天地海一体化通信网络的深度融合, 各种复杂应用场景的出现使得组合服务的种类和数量急剧增多, 结构也变得复杂。在云网融合环境下, 用户移动设备和边缘服务器等硬件能力有限, 能耗问题成为组合服务进行动态重构不可忽略的重要因素。此外, 传统方法并未考虑空天地海不同场景下用户对不同服务质量(QoS)属性需求的差异性, 使得组合服务的交付结果并不令人满意。为了解决上述问题, 提出一种基于多目标粒子群优化(PSO)的组合服务动态重构方法。该方法首先根据重构原子服务的三维空间地理位置和功能进行聚类, 有效解决在云网融合环境下服务规模庞大情况下的搜索空间爆炸问题; 然后通过能耗计算模型得到服务调用的综合能耗, 并将其作为动态重构的优化目标之一, 结合服务的多种QoS属性进行多目标寻优, 最终生成符合用户需求且能耗较低的重构方案。实验结果表明, 该方法在云网融合环境下节约能耗和应对较大候选服务

items.title: 基于多信息融合的高速收费站拥堵检测算法
items.title_zh: 基于多信息融合的高速收费站拥堵检测算法
items.summary_zh: 在高速收费站拥堵检测场景中, 遮挡、阴影、景深等因素严重影响检测算法的精度, 基于单信息的拥堵检测算法无法准确反映收费站真实拥堵情况, 对此, 提出一种高速收费站多信息融合拥堵检测算法。首先采用目标检测算法检测目标区域车辆, 利用图像空间特征计算车道占用率; 其次利用Deep SORT目标跟踪算法与滑动平衡机制进行车流量综合估计, 减少因为遮挡和阴影导致的车辆误检、漏检问题; 最后利用基于光流信息熵的车速估计方法, 降低因景深变化导致的拥堵状态检测误差。通过融合3种不同维度信息得到拥堵指数, 拥堵指数聚类为5种拥堵类别以判断真实拥堵状态, 从而实现高速收费站的拥堵检测。实验结果表明, 在高速收费站拥堵数据集上, 采用多信息融合的拥堵检测算法准确率达到90.4%, 能够实现对收费站拥堵状态的准确检测。

items.title: 语义对齐与自适应回放增强的动态多模态知识图谱持续补全
items.title_zh: 语义对齐与自适应回放增强的动态多模态知识图谱持续补全

items.title: 基于常识引导与多模态特征融合的视觉关系推理
items.title_zh: 基于常识引导与多模态特征融合的视觉关系推理

items.title: 基于大语言模型的源代码漏洞检测方法
items.title_zh: 基于大语言模型的源代码漏洞检测方法
items.summary_zh:
<p<针对现有大语言模型（large language model，LLM）在源代码漏洞检测中对程序结构信息利用不足、推理稳定性较弱以及微调成本较高等问题，提出一种融合图结构表征与LLM推理能力的漏洞检测方法。该方法以源代码数据流图为基础，对变量依赖关系和语义传播路径进行建模，并通过跨模态映射将图结构特征对齐到语言模型语义空间，实现程序结构知识的有效注入。同时，设计基于代码重构任务的渐进式图编码器预训练策略，以增强模型对漏洞相关结构模式的感知能力。在此基础上，结合结构化推理蒸馏与低秩自适应参数高效微调机制，在降低训练开销的同时提升漏洞判别性能。进一步，引入面向漏洞检测的思维链推理流程，增强检测结果的可解释性与推理一致性。实验结果表明，该方法能够有效提升源代码漏洞检测的准确性和稳定性。</p<

items.title: 高性能智算中心网络：现状、挑战与趋势
items.title_zh: 高性能智算中心网络：现状、挑战与趋势
items.summary_zh:
<p<智算中心是数据中心发展到当前的一种新形态，与传统以提供虚拟化计算资源为主要特征的云数据中心相比，智算中心主要为以人工智能为代表的新型高算力需求业务提供强大算力。针对智算中心网络业务需求、拓扑结构、通信模式、流量特征等进行了深入阐述与分析，针对其独有特征带来的新问题与挑战逐一进行剖析。然后，按照网络分层模型梳理了以集合通信、传输控制、负载均衡、链路控制和故障管理为核心的高性能智算中心网络关键技术框架，并对这些关键技术现状和优劣势进行了详细的归纳总结。最后，在对当前技术发展分析的基础上，提出了通算智算一体化、智算中心技术专用化、智能算力多租户化等未来发展趋势。</p<

items.title: Uncovering Cellular Resolution in scRNAseq via Unbiased Cell and Gene Network Analysis
items.title_zh: 通过无偏细胞和基因网络分析揭示scRNAseq中的细胞分辨率
items.summary_zh: 单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）数据的常规注释严重依赖手动、基于标记的阈值设定，这种方法可能掩盖细微的转录梯度，并将功能不同的细胞状态合并为广泛异质群体。这里我们将高斯多图模型（GmGM）框架应用于10x Genomics PBMC数据集，该框架从单个scRNA-seq数据矩阵联合推断细胞-细胞和基因-基因依赖结构。十次独立的GMGM-Leiden聚类运行通过软聚类集成方法整合为稳健的共识分区，并与参考细胞类型注释进行基准比较。该策略产生稳定的聚类分区，能解析参考注释未区分的生物学意义亚群。同时，对每个聚类，通过跨分辨率共识Leiden聚类从拟合模型中提取基因共表达模块，使用标准网络指标评估，并通过网络富集分析测试（NEAT）进行功能验证，确认非随机富集信号。模块评分程序将网络拓扑与每细胞、每聚类表达特征联系起来，并展示了GmGM的新扩展，在单次模型运行中恢复共享细胞-细胞网络和群体

extra.description: Conventional annotation of single-cell RNA-sequencing (scRNA-seq) data relies heavily on manual, marker-based thresholding, an approach that can obscure subtle transcriptomic gradients and collapse functionally distinct cell states into broad, heterogeneous populations. Here we apply the Gaussian multi-Graphical Model (GmGM) framework, which jointly infers cell-cell and gene-gene dependency structure from a single scRNA-seq data matrix, to a 10x Genomics PBMC dataset. Ten independent GMGM-Leiden clustering runs were integrated into a robust consensus partition using a soft cluster ensemble approach and benchmarked against reference cell-type annotations. This strategy yielded stable cluster partitions that resolve biologically meaningful sub-populations not distinguished by the reference annotation. In parallel, for each cluster, gene co-expression modules were extracted from the fitted model via consensus Leiden clustering across resolutions, evaluated using standard network metrics, and validated functionally with the Network Enrichment Analysis Test (NEAT), which confirmed non-random enrichment signal. A module-scoring procedure linked network topology to per-cell, per-cluster expression signatures, and a novel extension of GmGM, recovering a shared cell-cell network together with population-specific gene networks in a single model run, was demonstrated in a case study on the CD4+ T-cell population. These results indicate that GmGM provides a unified, reproducible framework for joint cell clustering and gene-network inference, capable of revealing cellular structure beyond that captured by conventional pipelines.

items.title: Fragment Path Complex Networks for Viral Genome Classification
items.title_zh: 用于病毒基因组分类的片段路径复形网络
items.summary_zh: 病毒科的准确分类对于理解基因组多样性至关重要，但快速进化和异质基因组结构使可靠归属变得复杂。新发现的病毒，尤其是来自代表性不足生态系统的病毒，扩展了病毒基因组的已知多样性。这种不断增长的多样性对依赖与现有参考相似性的分类方法构成挑战。我们提出片段路径复形网络（FPCN），一个将病毒基因组表示为不同尺度有序片段序列的框架。FPCN捕捉每个片段内的上下文序列信息，并使用路径复形建模相邻片段之间的复杂关系。我们在成熟的NCBI基准上评估FPCN，FPCN取得了高于竞争方法的分类准确率。对新发布数据集的进一步评估显示，FPCN能够泛化到训练中未出现的基因组。总之，这些结果使FPCN成为在基准数据集和新发布基因组中对已知科内病毒基因组进行分类的有效工具。

extra.description: Accurate classification of viral families is essential to understanding genomic diversity, but rapid evolution and heterogeneous genome structure complicate reliable assignment. Newly discovered viruses, particularly those from underrepresented ecosystems, expand the known diversity of viral genomes. This growing diversity poses challenges for classification methods that rely on similarity to existing references. We present Fragment Path Complex Networks (FPCN), a framework that represents viral genomes as sequences of ordered fragments at various scales. FPCN captures contextual sequence information within each fragment and uses path complexes to model complex relationships between neighboring fragments. We evaluated FPCN on well-established NCBI benchmarks, and FPCN achieved higher classification accuracy than competing methods. Further evaluations on newly released datasets revealed FPCN's ability to generalize to genomes that were not presented in the training. Together, these results position FPCN as an effective tool for classifying viral genomes within known families across benchmark datasets and newly released genomes.

items.title: From Imbalance to Evidence: Deep Nonparametric Testing for Complex Data under Severe Sample Imbalance
items.title_zh: 从失衡到证据：严重样本失衡下复杂数据的深度非参数检验
items.summary_zh: 在严重样本不平衡下比较分布，需要有效利用大量多数类观测，同时保持对较小样本相关差异的敏感性。这一挑战对复杂非欧几里得数据尤其重要，例如图数据，其结构特征需要灵活的检验方法。分类器双样本检验（C2STs）提供了这种灵活性，但现有方法主要针对平衡或规模相近的样本设计。本文研究高度不平衡情形下的C2STs，并表明严重样本不平衡可能显著降低检验性能。不同于传统不平衡学习仅将样本不平衡视为分类器训练的干扰，我们将其转化为重复检验证据的来源。基于这一洞见，我们提出增强型不平衡感知深度分类器双样本检验（EIAD-C2ST），这是一个与分类器无关、面向样本不平衡的框架，通过针对数据结构定制分类器来适配多种数据模态。对于计算代价高昂的深度分类器，我们进一步提出可扩展的表示摊销实现策略。理论上，我们建立了渐近 size 的严格保证，并刻画了功效一致性的条件，允许不平衡比发散。我们通过模拟和区块链取证应用展示了

extra.description: Comparing distributions under severe sample imbalance requires effectively using abundant majority observations while retaining sensitivity to differences involving the smaller sample. This challenge is particularly relevant for complex, non-Euclidean data, such as graphs, whose structural characteristics call for flexible testing procedures. Classifier two-sample tests (C2STs) provide such flexibility, but existing procedures are primarily designed for balanced or comparably sized samples. In this paper, we study C2STs in a highly imbalanced regime, and show that severe sample imbalance may substantially degrade testing performance. Different from conventional imbalanced learning approaches that treat sample imbalance merely as a nuisance for classifier training, we turn it into a source of repeated testing evidence. Building on this insight, we propose an Enhanced Imbalance-Aware Deep Classifier Two-Sample Test (EIAD-C2ST), a classifier-agnostic framework designed for sample imbalance that accommodates diverse data modalities by tailoring classifiers to data structure. For computationally expensive deep classifiers, we further develop a scalable representation-amortized implementation strategy. Theoretically, we establish rigorous guarantees on asymptotic size and characterize conditions for power consistency, allowing the imbalance ratio to diverge. We demonstrate the empirical gains using simulations and an application to blockchain forensics. The results reveal that the majority-sample surplus, when properly leveraged, can be organized into useful statistical evidence, rather than an obstacle, for distributional comparisons with complex data.

items.title: PhySeqNet: physics-informed fluorescent foci detection for BARseq spatial transcriptomics
items.title_zh: PhySeqNet：用于BARseq空间转录组学的物理信息荧光焦点检测
items.summary_zh: BARseq能够对完整组织进行空间分辨的基因表达谱分析，但其灵敏度取决于对密集荧光rolonies的准确检测和解码。现有spot-calling方法在信号重叠处可能偏保守，而监督深度学习则受限于真实组织图像中缺乏可靠的人工真值。这里我们提出PhySeqNet，一个用于BARseq中无需标注的荧光焦点检测的物理信息深度学习框架。PhySeqNet完全在与仪器匹配的光学模型结合真实无样本实验噪声生成的半合成图像上训练U-Net检测器，并集成到pyBARseq中，这是一个用于BARseq分析的模块化Python流程。PhySeqNet在留出的模拟数据上跨波长波段取得了高检测性能。在无法获得真值的真实组织图像上，我们通过前向模型重建评估检测：PhySeqNet结合保守的条形码感知非极大值抑制（NMSB）在重建保真度（NCC和MS-SSIM）上高于BarDensr单次估计器、调优的经典spot检测器

extra.description: BARseq enables spatially resolved gene-expression profiling across intact tissue, but its sensitivity depends on accurate detection and decoding of dense fluorescent rolonies. Existing spot-calling approaches can be conservative where signals overlap, while supervised deep learning is limited by the lack of reliable manual ground truth in real tissue images. Here we present PhySeqNet, a physics-informed deep learning framework for annotation-free fluorescent foci detection in BARseq. PhySeqNet trains U-Net detectors entirely on semi-synthetic images generated from an instrument-matched optical model combined with real sample-free experimental noise, and is integrated into pyBARseq, a modular Python pipeline for BARseq analysis. PhySeqNet achieved high detection performance on held-out simulated data across wavelength bands. On real tissue images, where ground truth is unavailable, we evaluated detections by forward-model reconstruction: PhySeqNet with conservative barcode-aware non-maxima suppression (NMSB) achieved higher reconstruction fidelity (NCC and MS-SSIM) than the BarDensr single-shot estimator, tuned classical spot detectors, and a pretrained deep-learning detector. In the analyzed brain section, PhySeqNet with NMSB yielded a median of 51 counts per cell versus 47 for BarDensr, with a similar number of genes detected per cell. The recovered transcripts produced spatial expression patterns qualitatively consistent with Allen MERFISH reference data and preserved cell-type composition after scANVI label transfer. These results show that physics-informed simulation can train practical, annotation-free detectors that improve BARseq sensitivity without disrupting downstream biological interpretation.

items.title: Truecell reproduces R Seurat's single-cell analysis outputs natively in the Python ecosystem
items.title_zh: Truecell 在 Python 生态中原生复现 R Seurat 的单细胞分析输出
items.summary_zh: 单细胞 RNA 测序分析主要使用 Seurat（R）或 Scanpy（Python），选择通常由编程语言偏好驱动。然而，默认情况下，这些工具产生不同的可变特征、邻居图、聚类和标记基因。需要 Python（支持大多数深度学习、基础模型和代理工具）的实验室必须在无法复现 Seurat 结果的框架中重新实现 Seurat 分析。Truecell 被开发为 Seurat 接口的 Python 实现，保留函数名称、参数、默认设置和对象模型，以促进分析的无缝转移。在十八个与 R Seurat 的配对端到端评估中，确定性输出匹配到浮点精度，并且折叠变化顺序在所有九个差异表达测试中相同。在三个数据集上的三臂基准测试中，固定用户参数和每个工具 20 个种子，Truecell 在所有 12 个数据集和分辨率设置组合中比配置 Seurat 的 Scanpy 更接近地复现 Seurat 的聚类。Truecell

extra.description: Single-cell RNA-sequencing analyses predominantly use either Seurat (R) or Scanpy (Python), with the choice often driven by programming language preference. However, by default, these tools produce divergent variable features, neighbour graphs, clusters, and marker genes. Laboratories requiring Python, which supports most deep-learning, foundation-model, and agent tools, must re-implement Seurat analyses in a framework that does not replicate Seurat's results. Truecell was developed as a Python implementation of the Seurat interface, preserving function names, arguments, default settings, and the object model to facilitate seamless transfer of analyses. In eighteen paired end-to-end evaluations against R Seurat, deterministic outputs matched to floating-point precision, and fold-change order was identical across all nine differential expression tests. In a three-arm benchmark on three datasets, with fixed user parameters and 20 seeds per tool, Truecell more closely reproduced Seurat's clustering than a Seurat-configured Scanpy in all 12 combinations of dataset and resolution settings. Truecell's marker genes and enriched pathways were also closer to Seurat's than Scanpy's were, and pseudobulk DESeq2 reproduced Seurat's gene lists with a Jaccard index ranging from 0.95 to 1.00. This agreement reflects fidelity to Seurat rather than biological correctness.

items.title: CellMSA: Context Modeling for Single-Cell Representation Learning

items.summary_zh: 单细胞转录组学能够以前所未有的分辨率分析细胞状态，但其高维性、稀疏性和技术批次效应对表示学习构成重大挑战。现有单细胞基础模型通常独立编码每个细胞，或仅对同一批次细胞建模以去噪，从而未充分利用跨批次和细胞类型的丰富关系信息来建模基因表达模式。我们认为，单细胞模型可以从更具信息量的细胞上下文建模中受益。通过比较细胞之间的一致性和变异，模型可以捕捉与细胞状态相关的细粒度基因–基因依赖关系，这对于学习高质量表示至关重要。受蛋白质建模中多序列比对（MSA）上下文使用的启发，我们提出CellMSA，一个将MSA启发式归纳偏置引入转录组建模的单细胞表示学习框架。对于每个目标细胞，CellMSA从不同批次和生物学相关细胞类型中检索相关细胞作为上下文，并将跨细胞模式总结为上下文依赖的基因对表示。然后将该表示注入成对感知的目标细胞编码器，以进行细粒度表示学习。我们在约1.09亿个细胞观测（包括6560万个主要

extra.description: Single-cell transcriptomics enables profiling of cellular states at unprecedented resolution, but its high dimensionality, sparsity, and technical batch effects pose significant challenges for representation learning. Existing single-cell foundation models typically encode each cell independently or only model cells from the same batch for denoising, thereby underutilizing the rich relational information across batches and cell types to model gene expression patterns. We argue that single-cell models can benefit from more informative cell-context modeling. By comparing consistency and variation across cells, models can capture fine-grained gene-gene dependencies associated with cell states, which are essential for learning high-quality representations. Inspired by the use of multiple sequence alignment (MSA) context in protein modeling, we propose CellMSA, a single-cell representation learning framework that introduces an MSA-inspired inductive bias into transcriptomic modeling. For each target cell, CellMSA retrieves relevant cells from different batches and biologically related cell types as context, and summarizes cross-cell patterns into a context-dependent gene-pair representation. This representation is then injected into a pair-aware target-cell encoder for fine-grained representation learning. We pretrain CellMSA on a large-scale human single-cell corpus of approximately 109 million cell observations, including 65.6 million primary observations. Experiments show that our framework consistently outperforms existing methods across multiple benchmarks. Code is available at the following repository: https://github.com/PharMolix/CellMSA.

items.title: Predictive Multiplicity in Cell-Fate Assignment: Label-Free Rashomon Sets and the Limits of Per-Cell Certification

extra.description: Single-cell trajectory inference maps transcriptomic measurements onto developmental continua, yet configurations that fit the data equally well can assign conflicting cell fates. FateMultiplicity is a label-free framework that constructs a statistically admissible model set, or Rashomon set, without lineage labels, by evaluating model discrepancy on cross-fitted held-out genes under non-inferiority testing calibrated against random-seed variation. Multiplicity is large and depends more on the diversity of the model space than its size: twelve configurations of a second algorithm expose 20.0% of cells where twenty-four of the first expose 3.8%. Whether the per-cell certified fate margin FM yields more reliable assignments than the fitted model already provides is then tested, and it does not. On simulation ground truth, on the same cells, FM discriminates misassignment at AUC 0.682, against 0.965 for the baseline configuration's own decision margin (p = 0.003) and 0.854 for a seed-dispersion baseline. Informativeness is governed by the breadth of the admitted set, not its cardinality: at cardinality four, seed refits give 0.933 and hyperparameter-perturbed sets 0.701. Relaxing the infimum to a q-quantile recovers discrimination but converges toward the single model's own confidence; the supremum reaches 0.973 because theta*'s membership bounds it from below, while the infimum is unanchored. Multiplicity in trajectory inference is worth measuring and reporting, but per-cell certification over a label-free Rashomon set is not a route to more reliable fate calls. Two constructions survive: a margin-erosion ratio separates real from spurious branch points in simulation (AUC 0.890, untested on real data), and against clonally observed fate, uncertified cells disagree with their clone's outcome 16.4 percentage points more often than certified cells (p < 0.001).

items.summary_zh: 糖尿病中异常的单核/巨噬细胞激活驱动慢性炎症和糖尿病并发症。尽管表观遗传机制被认为参与这些过程，但三维（3D）染色质重组的贡献仍不清楚。这里，我们使用整合多组学方法，对暴露于高糖和TNF-（HT）、模拟糖尿病环境的人CD14单核细胞来源巨噬细胞中的基因表达、染色质可及性和3D染色质结构进行谱分析。HT诱导的炎症转录程序重现了糖尿病中观察到的程序，并动态重塑染色质可及性、增强子-启动子相互作用和拓扑关联域。炎症基因表现出染色质可及性增加，而细胞周期和代谢基因则表现出可及性降低和增强子-启动子相互作用减弱。这些结构变化促进谱系决定和信号依赖转录因子在增强子-启动子环处汇聚，生成不同的调控枢纽以协调促炎反应。在糖尿病患者外周血来源单核细胞中也观察到类似的增强子-启动子相互作用。此外，通过CRISPR干扰靶向HT诱导增强子来扰动染色质相互作用，会抑制附近的CCL2和其他趋化因子基因。总之，这张糖尿

extra.description: Aberrant monocyte/macrophage activation in diabetes drives chronic inflammation and diabetic complications. Although epigenetic mechanisms are implicated in these processes, the contribution of three-dimensional (3D) chromatin reorganization remains unclear. Here, we use integrated multi-omics approaches to profile gene expression, chromatin accessibility and 3D chromatin architecture in human CD14 monocyte-derived macrophages exposed to high glucose and TNF- (HT), mimicking the diabetic milieu. HT induces inflammatory transcription programs that recapitulate those observed in diabetes and dynamically remodel chromatin accessibility, enhancer-promoter interactions, and topologically associated domains. Inflammatory genes exhibit increased chromatin accessibility, whereas cell cycle and metabolic genes display reduced accessibility and weakened enhancer-promoter interactions. These architectural changes promote the convergence of lineage-determining and signal-dependent transcription factors at enhancer-promoter loops, generating distinct regulatory hubs that orchestrate pro-inflammatory responses. Similar enhancer-promoter interactions are observed in peripheral blood derived monocytes from individuals with diabetes. Furthermore, perturbing chromatin interactions via CRISPR interference targeting HT-induced enhancers suppresses nearby CCL2 and other chemokine genes. Collectively, this first comprehensive enhancer connectome map of macrophages under diabetic conditions advances the field by revealing extensive disease-associated rewiring of the 3D epigenome, highlighting chromatin architecture and epigenetic mechanisms as potential therapeutic target for diabetes-associated inflammation.

items.title: Integrative Multi-omics Analysis of the Human Skeletal Muscle Response to Endurance or Resistance Exercise: Findings from the Molecular Transducers of Physical Activity Consortium (MoTrPAC)
items.title_zh: 人类骨骼肌对耐力或抗阻运动反应的综合多组学分析：来自身体活动分子转导联盟（MoTrPAC）的发现
items.summary_zh: 身体活动分子转导联盟（MoTrPAC）的建立旨在系统刻画运动健康益处的分子基础。这里，我们展示人类骨骼肌对急性耐力（EE）和抗阻（RE）运动的整合多组学反应。观察到不同的时间反应，ATAC-seq、磷酸化蛋白质组和代谢组的变化先于转录组和蛋白质组变化。这些不同的时间多组学动态用于识别围绕MEF2A和NFIC调控自噬、血管生成和代谢汇聚的转录调控枢纽。此外，早期RE特异性磷酸化蛋白质组特征抵消了表观遗传修饰，并下调了参与蛋白质周转的转录本。其他发现包括与急性运动调控肌节蛋白TTN、NEB、ANKRD2和LMOD2相关的HIPK2/3激酶特征受到抑制。我们的数据表明，人类骨骼肌多组学景观存在不同的时间调控，EE和RE引发共同和独特的分子特征。

extra.description: The Molecular Transducers of Physical Activity Consortium (MoTrPAC) was established to systematically characterize the molecular basis of the health benefits of exercise. Here, we present the integrative, multi-omics response of human skeletal muscle to acute endurance (EE) and resistance (RE) exercise. Distinct temporal responses were observed, with changes in ATAC-seq, phosphoproteome, and metabolome occurring before changes in the transcriptome and proteome. These distinct temporal multi-omic dynamics were used to identify transcriptional regulatory hubs converging around MEF2A and NFIC regulation of autophagy, angiogenesis and metabolism. Further, early RE-specific phosphoproteome signatures counteracted epigenetic modifications and downregulated transcripts involved in protein turnover. Additional findings include suppression of HIPK2/3 kinase signatures linked to the acute exercise regulation of sarcomeric proteins TTN, NEB, ANKRD2 and LMOD2. Our data demonstrate distinct temporal regulation across the multi-omic landscape of human skeletal muscle, with EE and RE eliciting common and unique molecular signatures.

items.title: CircuitATLAS: Agentic reasoning over a systems neuroscience knowledge graph for target discovery in circuitopathies
items.title_zh: CircuitATLAS：在系统神经科学知识图谱上进行代理推理以发现 circuitopathies 中的靶点
items.summary_zh: 神经疾病药物发现传统上聚焦于疾病改变的分子。但导致病理的分子未必是逆转病理的最佳切入点。在此，我们追问哪些原本未被改变的分子控制点可以被用来将病理神经环路恢复至功能状态。我们提出CircuitATLAS，一个基于溯源的系统神经科学知识图谱和智能体框架，用于环路病中的靶点发现。它结构化地整合了来自文献的跨疾病、表型、电生理、环路、脑区、细胞类型和分子效应器的关系，同时刻意排除直接的疾病-基因和疾病-蛋白边以减少捷径推理。该图谱包含383万个节点和766万条边，其中包括531万条LLM提取的关系，并整合了人类细胞图谱等结构化数据集和新的多模态在体测量。随后我们引入一个智能体工作流，从可测量的疾病表型出发，经由其环路和细胞基质，推理至分子干预、治疗可行性和临床约束。最后，我们引入一个人工治理的在体实验室在环，将假设生成与实验迭代连接起来。在该框架内，一个智能体提名ATP1A3——神经元alpha

extra.description: Drug discovery for neurological disease has traditionally centered on the molecules altered by disease. But the molecules that cause pathology are not necessarily the best points from which to reverse it. Here, we ask which otherwise unaltered molecular control points can be engaged to restore pathological neural circuits toward functional states. We present CircuitATLAS, a provenance-grounded systems-neuroscience knowledge graph and agentic framework for target discovery in circuitopathies. It structures literature-derived relationships across diseases, phenotypes, electrophysiology, circuits, brain regions, cell types and molecular effectors, while deliberately excluding direct disease-gene and disease-protein edges to reduce shortcut reasoning. The graph contains 3.83 million nodes and 7.66 million edges, including 5.31 million LLM-extracted relations, and incorporates structured datasets such as the Human Cell Atlas and new multimodal in vivo measurements. We then introduce an agentic workflow that reasons from measurable disease phenotypes through their circuit and cellular substrates to molecular interventions, therapeutic feasibility and clinical constraints. Finally, we introduce a human-governed in vivo lab-in-the-loop linking hypothesis generation to experimental iteration. Within this framework an agent nominated ATP1A3, the neuronal alpha3 Na+/K+-ATPase, as a control point on cortical excitability; interneuron-restricted expression of ATP1A3 abolished the beta- and gamma-band response to a focal 4-aminopyridine challenge in vivo, and the validated target was then carried into a structure-guided small-molecule campaign terminating in a defined assay to resolve the direction of modulation. CircuitATLAS thus provides a framework for discovering therapeutics based not only on what is molecularly disrupted in disease, but on what can be controlled to restore circuit function.

items.title: Protocol for Discovering Convergent Molecular Networks across Multi-Omics Datasets Using Network Propagation
items.title_zh: 使用网络传播跨多组学数据集发现趋同分子网络的方案
items.summary_zh: 表型结果源于分子层之间的协调变化。尽管多组学数据捕捉互补的分子信号，但由于基因水平重叠有限，将其整合为连贯的生物机制仍然具有挑战性。网络传播将每个数据集中的重要基因命中映射到先验知识分子相互作用网络上，并将其信号扩散到邻近基因。对传播网络进行数学整合，随后进行聚类和通路富集，可揭示共享分子网络，从而指出跨正交分子层捕捉到的核心生物学。

extra.description: Phenotypic outcomes arise from coordinated changes across molecular layers. Although multi-omics data capture complementary molecular signals, integrating them into coherent biological mechanisms remains challenging due to limited overlap at the gene level. Network propagation maps significant gene hits from each dataset onto a prior knowledge molecular interaction network and diffuses their signals to neighboring genes. Mathematical integration of propagated networks, followed by clustering and pathway enrichment, reveals shared molecular networks, pinpointing the core biology captured across orthogonal molecular layers.

items.title: BaseCamp --- An Agentic AI Framework for Automating DNA Sequencing Data Pipelines
items.title_zh: BaseCamp --- 一种用于自动化 DNA 测序数据流程的智能体 AI 框架
items.summary_zh: DNA 测序流程，涵盖质量控制、比对、变异检测和注释，如今已由工作流管理系统可靠执行，这些系统大规模编排成熟的生物信息学工具。仍然依赖人工的是围绕该执行的决策层：选择适合样本和平台的质量阈值、裁定边界变异检测、诊断异常，以及确定哪些发现值得专家审查。这些决策重复、判断密集、在不同操作者之间不一致，且常常未被记录。本文介绍 BaseCamp，一种用于自动化 DNA 测序流程决策层的新型智能体 AI 框架。该框架将流程分解为六个专门 AI 智能体，涵盖样本接收和质量控制、比对、变异检测、注释、跨阶段监测和报告。关键的是，BaseCamp 智能体不执行序列分析：成熟工具执行比对、检测和注释，而智能体在其中选择、配置、解释其输出并决定后续步骤。这将语言模型推理限制在其可靠的判断层，并保留现有工具保证的可重复性。智能体推理由一个经过微调、领域专门化的大型语言模型联盟驱动，由中央推理 LLM 协调，在

extra.description: DNA sequencing pipelines, spanning quality control, alignment, variant calling, and annotation, are now reliably executed by workflow management systems that orchestrate established bioinformatics tools at scale. What remains manual is the decision layer surrounding that execution: selecting quality thresholds appropriate to a sample and platform, adjudicating borderline variant calls, diagnosing anomalies, and determining which findings warrant expert review. These decisions are repetitive, judgment-intensive, inconsistent across operators, and frequently undocumented. This paper introduces BaseCamp, a novel agentic AI framework for automating the decision layer of DNA sequencing pipelines. The framework decomposes the pipeline into six specialized AI agents, covering sample intake and quality control, alignment, variant calling, annotation, cross-stage monitoring, and reporting. Critically, BaseCamp agents do not perform sequence analysis: established tools execute alignment, calling, and annotation, while the agents select among them, configure them, interpret their output, and decide what follows. This confines language model reasoning to the judgment layer where it is reliable and preserves the reproducibility existing tooling guarantees. Agent reasoning is powered by a consortium of fine-tuned, domain-specialized large language models coordinated by a central reasoning LLM, executing locally so no sequencing data leaves the operating environment, under human-in-the-loop orchestration. Evaluation shows agent-generated configurations are concordant with expert practice, that an explicit filtering ledger renders inspectable what filtering otherwise removes without trace, and that cross-stage anomaly detection surfaces conditions execution monitoring misses. BaseCamp offers a generalizable blueprint for agentic automation of scientific data pipelines.

items.title: Orchestra: Corroboration-Based Regulatory Candidate Discovery via Composed Bioinformatics MCP Agents
items.title_zh: Orchestra：通过组合生物信息学MCP智能体进行基于佐证的调控候选发现
items.summary_zh: Orchestra将两个独立构建的生物信息学MCP服务器——RegNetAgents（从ARACNe网络推断基因调控网络拓扑）和CASCADE（提供四个独立证据源：LINCS敲低、DepMap必需性、超级增强子状态、DoRothEA转录因子置信度）——组合成一个通过模型上下文协议暴露的多智能体工作流。其核心架构主张是，要求RegNetAgents的拓扑证据和CASCADE的实验证据在候选调控因子上达成一致，比任一单独来源产生更可信的候选——此前未直接测试，因为RegNetAgents自身的验证仅询问其候选列表是否优于随机。我们在TCGA肿瘤获得性调控因子层级（基因肿瘤ARACNe网络中但不在GREmLN群体平均基线中的调控因子）上测试，通过ARACNe互信息（MI）边权重选择候选。在RegNetAgents已发表的BRCA/COAD焦点基因面板及匹配阴性对照上，CASCADE 4个来源中至

extra.description: Orchestra composes two independently built bioinformatics MCP servers -- RegNetAgents, which infers gene regulatory network topology from ARACNe networks, and CASCADE, which supplies four independent evidence sources (LINCS knockdown, DepMap essentiality, super-enhancer status, DoRothEA transcription-factor confidence) -- into one multi-agent workflow exposed via the Model Context Protocol. Its central architectural claim is that requiring RegNetAgents' topology evidence and CASCADE's experimental evidence to agree on a candidate regulator yields a more trustworthy candidate than either alone -- not previously tested directly, since RegNetAgents' own validation asked only whether its candidate lists beat chance. We test this on the TCGA tumor-acquired regulator tier (regulators in a gene's tumor ARACNe network but absent from the GREmLN population-averaged baseline), selecting candidates by ARACNe mutual-information (MI) edge weight. On RegNetAgents' published BRCA/COAD focal-gene panel plus matched negative controls, agreement among at least 2 of the 4 CASCADE sources predicts OncoKB cancer-gene status among focal genes (odds ratio 2.89, Benjamini-Hochberg-adjusted p=0.0166) but not among negative controls (p=0.0721); a single source is not diagnostic for either group. The pattern replicates and strengthens in a third cancer type, STAD, on a separately constructed panel (odds ratio 5.82), and against an independently curated ground truth (the Sanger COSMIC Cancer Gene Census). MI edge weight is the strongest single predictor overall (p=0.0003); a logistic-regression likelihood-ratio test confirms corroboration adds value beyond it in both panels (p=0.0234; p=0.0001). Every experiment invokes Orchestra's real agentic entry point.

items.title: Can Language Models Play the Wikipedia Game?
items.title_zh: 语言模型能玩维基百科游戏吗？
items.summary_zh: 语言模型越来越多地支持或自动化从大到无法索引的文档集合中进行信息检索。当任务需要专业语言或科学知识时，这一任务很困难。我们使用维基百科游戏在类似的信息检索任务上测试语言模型。在游戏中，玩家必须仅使用文章链接到达目标文章。我们比较了句子嵌入模型和LLM在五种维基百科语言和五个学术文献数据集上的表现。我们使用OpenAlex构建非常大的维基百科页面和论文引用本地图，并提供构建和导航它们的代码。这使得无需依赖第三方API即可研究语言模型的导航能力。我们将模型与人类和TF-IDF基准进行比较。维基百科游戏格式支持跨技术、语言和领域的稳健比较。没有模型显著优于人类，尽管最佳模型（GPT-o3 mini、GPT-4o、QwQ:32B和DeepSeek-R1:70B）取得了相当的成功。性能和排名因语言和主题而异，这对使用这些技术的实践者具有启示。

extra.description: Language models increasingly support or automate information retrieval from document collections too large to index. This task is difficult when it requires specialist linguistic or scientific knowledge. We used the Wikipedia Game to test language models on an analogous information retrieval task. In the game, players must reach a target article using only article links. We compared sentence embedding models and LLMs across five Wikipedia languages and five academic-literature datasets. We construct very large local graphs of Wikipedia pages and of paper citations using OpenAlex and provide code to build and navigate them. This allows the study of language models' navigation capabilities without relying on third-party APIs. We compared the models with human and TF-IDF benchmarks. The Wikipedia Game format enables robust comparisons across techniques, languages, and domains. No model significantly outperformed humans, although the best models (GPT-o3 mini, GPT-4o, QwQ:32B, and DeepSeek-R1:70B) achieved comparable success. Performance and rankings varied across languages and topics, with implications for practitioners utilising these techniques.

items.title: Revisiting Tabular Deep Regression: Objectives and the Limits of Global Early Stopping
items.title_zh: 重新审视表格深度回归：目标函数与全局早停的局限
items.summary_zh: 尽管表格数据深度学习模型最近受到显著研究关注，但回归任务目标函数的选择仍是一个研究不足的自由度。多条研究路线提供了标准均方误差（MSE）的替代方案，但数据集、骨干网络和评估协议的差异使其实际收益难以比较。在这项工作中，我们通过对广泛既有表格数据集和多种神经骨干网络进行回归目标的系统重新评估来填补这一空白。我们的比较表明，许多提出的目标相对于适当调优的MSE基线仅提供有限或不一致的增益，而分位数损失在测试骨干网络上相对MSE产生一致的总体改进。然后我们识别出即使使用这一强目标仍然存在的局限：具有不同目标噪声水平的区域可能在不同训练轮次达到最佳预测性能。因此，即使目标能够表示异方差目标分布，单一全局早停检查点也会在不同不确定性区域之间施加折中。受此局限启发，我们引入分位数损失的异方差感知扩展，使用输入依赖标签平滑作为潜在补救，并在多个骨干网络上优于分位数损失。总体而言，我们的结果为表格深度学习

extra.description: While deep learning models for tabular data have recently received significant research attention, the choice of objective functions for regression tasks remains an understudied degree of freedom. Several lines of research offer alternatives to the standard Mean Squared Error (MSE), but differences in datasets, backbones, and evaluation protocols make their practical benefits difficult to compare. In this work, we address this gap by performing a systematic re-evaluation of regression objectives across a broad collection of established tabular datasets and multiple neural backbones. Our comparison reveals that many proposed objectives provide limited or inconsistent gains over a properly tuned MSE baseline, while quantile loss yields consistent aggregate improvements over MSE across the tested backbones. We then identify a limitation that remains even with this strong objective: regions with different levels of target noise can reach their best predictive performance at different training epochs. Consequently, a single global early-stopping checkpoint can impose a compromise between uncertainty regions, even when the objective can represent heteroskedastic target distributions. Motivated by this limitation, we introduce a heteroskedasticity-aware extension of quantile loss that uses input-dependent label smoothing as a potential remedy and improves over quantile loss on several backbones. Overall, our results provide a modern empirical picture of regression objectives for tabular deep learning and highlight how differences in optimal stopping times across uncertainty regions can limit the effectiveness of global early stopping. The code is available at https://github.com/yandex-research/tabular-regression.

extra.description: Large language models reuse the same attention heads across tasks, but identifying these shared heads does not explain what they do differently in each task. A natural source of inspiration is task-dependent interactions among shared brain regions, which motivate a network view of language-model computation. Here, we compare fixed model components across tasks using identical graph facts, statements specifying which directed connections are present. We measure how interventions affect attention heads and the activation state in later layers (influence), as well as the answer (importance). Task changes redistribute the influence in five open-weight models spanning four families and 1.5-14 billion parameters. In Gemma-2-9B and Qwen3-14B, an activation edit changes an early internal activation vector and switches which fact the model reads while the written instruction stays fixed. The same heads then respond to different graph facts and influence later components differently. For each prompt, we construct two linear response maps, one before the edit and one after it. Each map predicts a later head's response from a measured change in an earlier head. For a separate factual intervention, the map for the corresponding condition reduces mean squared prediction error by 53.6% in Gemma and 5.0% in Qwen compared with the average of the two maps. These findings show that task context changes both which graph facts the shared components respond to and how their outputs affect later computation. A network account may help explain how models use shared parameters to perform different computations. Measurements of task-dependent influence could also guide interventions intended to alter one behavior while preserving others.

items.title: RATED: Reliability-Aware AI Agent Tool Retrieval via Execution Dynamics
items.title_zh: RATED：通过执行动态实现可靠性感知的AI智能体工具检索
items.summary_zh: 随着AI智能体越来越依赖外部工具，准确检索对可靠行为至关重要。现有方法优化语义相关性，但在很大程度上忽略执行期间的工具可用性。为填补这一空白，我们提出RATED（通过执行动态实现可靠性感知工具检索），一个结合稳健语义匹配与动态可靠性适配的检索框架。RATED采用冻结双编码器并通过对比微调进行语义匹配，以及一个轻量级上下文bandit模块，根据实时执行反馈对候选重新排序。这种设计能够快速适应运行时工具故障，而无需昂贵的模型重训练。我们引入EcoAgent，一个包含5,172个真实世界工具和超过210,000个查询-工具对的基准，用于离线检索和动态可靠性评估。实验结果表明，RATED在真实世界查询上相比ToolLLM API检索器实现52.2%的相对MRR提升，并在30%失败率的严重API中断场景下将故障选择率从86.2%降至2.9%，同时相比仅编码推理产生可忽略的低于1 ms延迟开销。代码和

extra.description: As AI agents increasingly rely on external tools, accurate retrieval is essential for reliable behavior. Existing methods optimize semantic relevance but largely ignore tool availability during execution. To address this gap, we propose RATED (Reliability-Aware Tool Retrieval via Execution Dynamics), a retrieval framework that combines robust semantic matching with dynamic reliability adaptation. RATED employs a frozen dual-encoder with contrastive fine-tuning for semantic matching, and a lightweight contextual bandit module that re-ranks candidates based on real-time execution feedback. This design enables rapid adaptation to runtime tool failures without expensive model retraining. We introduce EcoAgent, a benchmark of 5,172 real-world tools and over 210,000 query-tool pairs for offline retrieval and dynamic reliability evaluation. Experimental results demonstrate that RATED achieves a 52.2% relative MRR improvement over the ToolLLM API retriever on real-world queries, and reduces fault selection rate from 86.2% to 2.9% under severe API outage scenarios with a 30% failure rate, while incurring negligible latency overhead of less than 1 ms over encode-only inference. The code and dataset are available at https://github.com/Elliotes/EcoAgent.
